parameters.n_customers: <int> Number of customers to be visited by the vehicle.
parameters.total_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph, including the depot and all customers.
parameters.H: <int> Number of consecutive time periods that partition the planning horizon.
parameters.b_h: <list[float], length H> Global congestion factor for each time period, representing the lightest congestion level on the network during that period.
parameters.time_horizon_T: <float> End time of the planning horizon, within which the vehicle must complete its tour.
parameters.period_boundaries: <list[float], length H+1> Start and end times of each time period, from time zero to the end of the horizon.

depot.index: <int> Index of the depot vertex in the vertex list.

vertices.count: <int> Total number of vertices including the depot.
vertices.coordinates: <list[list[float]], shape [total_vertices][2]> X and Y coordinates of each vertex, starting with the depot at index 0 followed by each customer.
vertices.zones: <list[str], length total_vertices> Concentric traffic zone assignment for each vertex based on its distance from the depot.

arcs.distances: <list[list[float]], shape [total_vertices][total_vertices]> Euclidean travel distance from vertex i to vertex j for every ordered pair of vertices.
arcs.max_speeds_u_ij: <list[list[float]], shape [total_vertices][total_vertices]> Maximum achievable travel speed on the arc from vertex i to vertex j across all time periods.
arcs.speeds_v_ijh: <list[list[list[float]]], shape [total_vertices][total_vertices][H]> Travel speed on the arc from vertex i to vertex j during each time period.
arcs.delta_ijh: <list[list[list[float]]], shape [total_vertices][total_vertices][H]> Arc-specific congestion degradation factor for the arc from vertex i to vertex j during each time period.
